q: The H.C.F. of two numbers is 23 and the other two factors of their L.C.M. are 13 and 14. The larger of the two numbers is:
s: The HCF of a group of numbers will be always a factor of their LCM. HCF is the product of all common prime factors using the least power of each common prime factor. LCM is the product of highest powers of all prime factors. Clearly, the numbers are (23 x 13) and (23 x 14) ∴ Larger number = (23 x 14) = 322

q: Six bells commence tolling together and toll at intervals of 2, 4, 6, 8 10 and 12 seconds respectively. In 30 minutes, how many times do they toll together ?

q: Let N be the greatest number that will divide 1305, 4665 and 6905, leaving the same remainder in each case. Then sum of the digits in N is:
s: Understanding the Question: This question asks us to find the largest number (N) that divides three given numbers (1305, 4665, and 6905) and leaves the same remainder in each division. After finding N, we need to calculate the sum of its digits . Key Concept: Finding N If a number 'N' leaves the same remainder 'R' when dividing numbers 'a', 'b', and 'c', then (a-b), (b-c), and (c-a) are perfectly divisible by N. In other words, 'N' is the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of the differences between the numbers. Steps to Solve: 1. Calculate the differences: * 4665 - 1305 = 3360 * 6905 - 4665 = 2240 * 6905 - 1305 = 5600 2. Find the HCF of these differences (3360, 2240, and 5600): The HCF of these numbers is 1120. Therefore, N = 1120 3. Calculate the sum of the digits of N: * 1 + 1 + 2 + 0 = 4 Conclusion: The sum of the digits in N is 4. Therefore, the correct option is A: 4

q: If the sum of two numbers is 36 and their HCF and LCM are 3 and 105 respectively, the sum of the reciprocals of the numbers is = ?
s: Let the number be a and b $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Then,}} \\ & a + b = 36\ \text{and} \\ & ab = 3 \times 105 = 315 \\ & \therefore {\text{Required sum}} \\ & {\text{ = }}\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} \\ & = \frac{{a + b}}{{ab}} \\ & = \frac{{36}}{{315}} \\ & = \frac{4}{{35}} \end{aligned}$$

q: The LCM of two numbers is 12 times their HCF. The sum of HCF and LCM is 403. If one number is 93, find the other = ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let HCF be }}h{\text{ and LCM be }}l \\ & {\text{Then }}l = {\text{ }}12h{\text{ and}} \\ & {\text{ }}l + h{\text{ }} = {\text{ }}403 \\ & \therefore 12h + h = 403{\text{ or }}h = {\text{ }}31 \\ & {\text{So }}l{\text{ = }}\left( {403 - 31} \right) = 372 \\ & {\text{Hence other number}} \\ & {\text{ = }}\left( {\frac{{31 \times 372}}{{93}}} \right) = 124 \end{aligned}$$

q: What least number must be subtracted from 1936 so that the resulting number when divided by 9, 10 and 15 will leave in each case the same remainder 7 ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{LCM of }}\left( {9,10,15} \right) \\ & = 3 \times 3 \times 10 \\ & = 90 \\ & \frac{{1936}}{{90}},{\text{remainder = 46}} \end{aligned}$$ Least number when is subtracted from 1936 which gives remainder 7 when divided by (9, 10, 15) is = (46 - 7) = 39

q: The smallest number, which when increased by 5 is divisible by each of 24, 32, 36 and 64 is ?
The LCM of two numbers is 44 times of their of HCF. The sum of the LCM and HCF is 1125. If one number is 25 then the other number is = ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let HCF = }}x \\ & {\text{LCM = 44}}x \\ & {\text{given HCF + LCM}} \\ & = 44x + x = 45x \\ & 45x = {\text{ }}112{\text{5}} \\ & x = \frac{{1125}}{{45}} = 25 \\ & \therefore {\text{HCF}} = {\text{25}} \\ & {\text{LCM = 25}} \times {\text{44}} \\ & {\text{also given that one number}} \\ & {\text{ = 25}} \\ & {\text{Let another number = }}y \\ & \therefore 25y = 25 \times 25 \times 44 \\ & y = \frac{{25 \times 25 \times 44}}{{25}} \\ & y = 1100 \end{aligned}$$

q: The LCM of three different numbers is 120. Which of the following cannot be their HCF ?
s: Since HCF is always a factor of LCM, we cannot have three numbers with HCF 35 and LCM 120.

q: The greatest number for four digits which when divided by 12, 16 and 24 leave remainder 2,6 and 14 respectively is = ?
s: 12 - 2 = 10 16 - 6 = 10 24 - 14 = 10 LCM of (12, 16, 24) = 6 × 2 × 4 × 1 = 48 Greatest number of four digits = 9999 ∴ When it is divided by 48 we get remainder = 15 ⇒ The greatest number of 4 digits which completely divides the given number is = 9999 - 15 = 9984 ∴ Number is = 9984 - 10 = 9974

q: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4. The product of their HCF and LCM is 2028. The sum of the numbers is = ?
s: Let the numbers are = 3x, 4x respectively ∴ HCF = x LCM = 3 × 4 × x = 12x given that = HCF × LCM => x × 12x = 2028 => 12x 2 = 2028 => x 2 = 169 => x = 13 ∴ sum of numbers = 3x + 4x = 7x = 7 × 13 = 91

q: Sum of two numbers is 384. HCF of the numbers is 48. The difference of the numbers is = ?
s: HCF = 48 Let number are 48x and 48y respectively $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow 48x + 48y = 384 \\ & \left( {x + y} \right) = \frac{{384}}{{48}} = 8 \end{aligned}$$ So, possible pairs of co-prime number are (1, 7) (3, 5) numbers are (48, 336) or (144, 240) ∴ difference between numbers is = 336 - 48 = 288 and 240 - 144 = 96

q: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 21 and 4641 respectively. If one of the numbers lies between 200 and 300 , the two numbers are ?
s: Product of number = 21 × 4641 = 97461 Let the numbers be 21a and 21b Then 21a × 21b = 97461 ab = 221 Now, co-primes with product 221 are (1, 221) and (13, 17) So, the numbers are (21 × 1, 21 × 221) and (21 × 13, 21 × 17) Since one number lies between 200 and 300, the suitable pair is (273, 357)

q: The LCM of two multiples of 12 is 1056. If one of the number is 132, the other number is ?
s: Let number be 12x and 12y respectively LCM = 12xy 12xy = 1056 (given) xy = 88 ∴ Possible pairs are (1, 88), (8, 11) Possible numbers are = (12, 1056)(96, 132) given that one number is 132 so other is 96

q: The product of two numbers is 396 × 576 and their LCM is 6336. Find their HCF = ?
s: We, know that (a × b) = (HCF and LCM) 396 × 576 = HCF × 6336 HCF = 36

q: The greatest number, which when subtracted from 5834, gives a number exactly divisible by each of 20, 28, 32 and 35 is ?

21 mango trees, 42 apple trees and 56 orange trees have to be planted in rows such that each row contains the same numbers of trees of one variety only. Minimum number of row in which the trees may be planted is = ?
s: For the minimum number of rows, the numbers of trees in each row must be the maximum. Number of trees in each row = HCF of 21, 42, 56 = 7 Hence number of rows $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{ = }}\left( {\frac{{21 + 42 + 56}}{7}} \right) \\ & = \frac{{119}}{7} \\ & = 17 \end{aligned}$$

q: The greatest possible length which can be used to measure exactly the lengths 7m, 3m 85cm, 12m 95cm is = ?
s: Required length = HCF of 700cm, 385cm and 1295cm = 35cm

q: Two numbers are in the ratio 3:4. Their LCM is 84. The greater number is ?
s: Let numbers are = 3x & 4x respectively LCM = 84 (given) ∴ LCM number = common factor (other factors) x × 3 × 4 = 12x ⇒ 12x = 84 ⇒ x = 7 ∴ Number are = 3x = 7 × 3 = 21 4x = 7 × 4 = 28 greater number is 28

q: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 12 and 924 respectively. Then the number of such pair is = ?
s: HCF = 12 Let numbers are 12x and 12y respectively LCM ⇒ 12xy = 924(given) ⇒ xy = 77 ⇒ Possible pairs are = (1 × 77) (7 × 11) ∴ Only two pairs are possible

q: The LCM of two numbers is 520 and their HCF is 4. If one of the numbers is 52, then the other number is = ?
s: LCM = 520 HCF = 4 one number = 52 Let other number is y 52y = 4 × 520 ⇒ y = 40

q: The capacity of two pots is 120 litres and 56 litres respectively. Find the capacity of a container which can exactly measure the contents of the two pots = ?
s: Required capacity = HCF of 120 litres and 56 litres = 8 litres = 8000 cc [∴ 1 litres = 1000 cc]

q: A daily wage labourer was engaged for a certain number of days for Rs. 5750, but being absent on some of those days he was paid only Rs. 5000. What was his maximum possible daily wage ?
s: Try to solve these kind of question by option Because of his being absent he was paid Rs. 750 less. Now check with option. Since maximum possible daily wages is asked so it will be Rs. 250 OR : Maximum possible daily wage = HCF of Rs. 5750 and Rs. 5000 = Rs. 250

q: The product of two numbers is 2028 and their HCF is 13. The number of such of pair is = ?
s: HCF = 13 (given) Let number are 13x & 13y respectively $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Also given}} \\ & 13x \times 13y = 2028 \\ & 13 \times 13 \times xy = 2028 \\ & xy = \frac{{2028}}{{13 \times 13}} = 12 \\ & \therefore {\text{Possible pairs are}} \\ & {\text{ = }}\left( {1,12} \right)\left( {3,4} \right) \end{aligned}$$ Only two pair are possible
